context.description: The status writer writes every committed step and stops at the end

evidence.trustReason: Live RunSupervisor and Recorder store run.started, task steps and final wall-clock stop; test folds stored facts and matches every distinct projected macrostep in order, once, with done last. Logged TaskStatus.write reads each file back and checks aliveAt against the write clock and fact times. Heartbeat and burst tests require touches to repeat only the immediately consumed snapshot with a fresh time; after done, another touch, record and heartbeat interval produce no write.

context.gherkin:
Scenario: SV16 The status writer writes every committed step and stops at the end
    Given a live run
    When facts are recorded and the heartbeat touches the file
    Then the file is written once for each committed macrostep, the final one included
    And each write stamps the heartbeat time
    And a touch rewrites the last consumed snapshot and never an older one
    And nothing writes the file after the done snapshot

  @phase2 @compat
